senses.gloss: शैनेय शैनेय, probably शिनि + एय, m. Satyaki, the charioteer of Kṛṣṇa, MBh. 7, 7242.

सैंह सैंह, i. e. सिंह + अ, adj., f. ही,
 1. Inherent in a lion, Hit. i. d. 174. M.M.
 2. Lion-like.

सैंहिक सैंहिक,
 I. i. e. सिंह + इक, [] adj. Lion-like.
 II. i. e. सिंहिका + अ, metronym., m. Rāhu.
सैंहिकेय सैंहिकेय, i. e. सिंहिका + एय, metronym., m. Rāhu.
सैनापत्य सैनापत्य, i. e. सेना-पति + य, n. The command of an army, Man. 12, 100; generalship, Vikr. d. 161.

सैनिक सैनिक, i. e. सेना + इक,
 I. adj. Belonging or relating to an army.
 II. m.
 1. A soldier, Hit. ii. d. 82; Rājat. 5, 430.
 2. A guard, a picket.
 3. A body of forces in array.

सैन्धव सैन्धव, i. e. सिन्धु + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Marine.
 2. Produced or born in Sindh, Johns. Sel. 96, 73.
 II. m. and n. Rock-salt.
 III. m.
 1. A horse.
 2. pl. The people of the country along the Indus, Draup. 6, 6.
सैन्धवक सैन्धव + क, adj. Relating to the Saindhavas (see the last); with नृप, their king, Draup. 8, 42.

सैन्य सैन्य, i. e. सेना + य,
 I. m.
 1. A soldier, Rājat. 5, 216.
 2. A guard.
 II. n. An army, Hit. iii. d. 79.
 --Comp.
